Name: Custom Backpack Framework
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod you can customize the backpack upgrade system, allowing for larger backpacks beyond 36 slots!

This mod adds scroll capability to the inventory grid. Scroll using the mouse scroll wheel, up and down arrow keys, or up and down on a controller. You can also click on the arrow keys and scroll bar with the mouse.

There is also a + button beside the inventory grid to show an expanded view of the inventory.

This mod does change backpack upgrades by itself. You need a mod that uses this framework, like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13827]More Backpack Upgrades[/url].


[youtube]YwCpYcetTYA[/youtube]


You can create your own Content Patcher mod to set custom backpack upgrades like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13827]More Backpack Upgrades[/url].

You can also manually set your backpack size using the SMAPI console, e.g.:

[b]custombackpack 60[/b]

to set your backpack slots to 60. Only use multiples of 12.


[b][size=5]Content Patcher
[/size][/b]
An example content.json file would be:

[code]{
    "Format": "1.23.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.CustomBackpack/dictionary",
            "Entries": {
                "24": {
                    "name": "Large Backpack",
                    "cost": 2000,
                    "texturePath": "aedenthorn.CPCustomBackpacks/backpacks",
                    "textureRect":
                    {
                        "X":0,
                        "Y":0,
                        "Width": 12,
                        "Height":14
                    }
                }
        },
        {
            "Action": "Load",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.CPCustomBackpacks/backpacks",
            "FromFile": "assets/backpacks.png"
        }
    ]
}
[/code]

[b]textureRect[/b] refers to the part of the texture used for the specific backpack.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
